## Hypothesis

Porting the AGG_RECONCILE_FILL_APPENDED scan-pnl-statement-for-unrecorded-fills step from eod-flatten-aggressive.py into core eod-flatten.py ensures both safe and aggressive EOD-flatten jobs journal unrecorded fills, preventing state drift and complying with Rule 8 (auditability of fills). ## Mechanism

The AGG_RECONCILE_FILL_APPENDED step scans the P&L statement for fills not yet recorded in the journal and appends them. Currently exists only in eod-flatten-aggressive.py. We will duplicate this step into eod-flatten.py (safe version) at the appropriate point in the EOD sequence, ensuring both safe and aggressive paths execute identical fill-reconciliation logic.
